WHO End TB Strategy milestones and targets

Source: R/data.R
tb_targets.Rd

The percentage reductions in TB incidence rate and TB deaths, relative to 2015, that the WHO End TB Strategy sets for 2020, 2025, 2030 and 2035. tb_required_reduction() interpolates between these points. See data-raw/tb_targets.R for how the table is built.

Usage

tb_targets

Format

A tibble with 10 rows and 4 variables:

indicator

Either "incidence" (TB incidence rate, as in tb_burden$incidence_rate) or "mortality" (the number of TB deaths, as in tb_burden$mortality_n).

year

Milestone or target year (2015, 2020, 2025, 2030, 2035).

reduction_pct

Required percentage reduction compared with 2015. Zero in the baseline year.

type

One of "baseline", "milestone", "SDG target", "End TB target".

Source

World Health Organization (2015). The End TB Strategy. Geneva: WHO. Milestones are reductions in the TB incidence rate and in the absolute number of TB deaths, each compared with 2015.

Examples

tb_targets
#> # A tibble: 10 × 4
#>    indicator  year reduction_pct type         
#>    <chr>     <int>         <dbl> <chr>        
#>  1 incidence  2015             0 baseline     
#>  2 incidence  2020            20 milestone    
#>  3 incidence  2025            50 milestone    
#>  4 incidence  2030            80 SDG target   
#>  5 incidence  2035            90 End TB target
#>  6 mortality  2015             0 baseline     
#>  7 mortality  2020            35 milestone    
#>  8 mortality  2025            75 milestone    
#>  9 mortality  2030            90 SDG target   
#> 10 mortality  2035            95 End TB target
